findings: Encoding: a formation of congruences is a dependent choice function F : (A : SSet S) -> Set (SortedEqv (TAlg Sig A).1) with (1) each F A a nonempty, meet-closed, refinement-up-closed set of congruences on T_Sigma(A), and (2) closure under kernel pullback along Theta-epimorphisms (homomorphisms whose composite with pr^Theta is surjective). The 'filter of Cgr(T_Sigma(A))' condition is inlined since Set is predicate-based (no bundled congruence lattice).
